notes: METHOD/CAVEATS: Direct fetches to bluedot.org (and aisafetyfundamentals.com, web.archive.org, most other hosts) are blocked by this session's network egress proxy, so the live pages could not be loaded directly. The list above was reconstructed and cross-verified from: (1) a verbatim HTML scrape of the live course made 2026-08-20 (github.com/Arkleseisure/Arkleseisure.github.io, file curricula-tech-7c2a.html, whose header states it was 'scraped from bluedot.org' with BlueDot's own text; its sidebar structure, chunk titles, durations, and resource lists match the live site's Google-indexed snippets checked via web search); (2) two independent participants' full course-note repos from the same 2026 course version (github.com/canivel/technical-ai-safety and github.com/laudominik/personal-notes seminars/TAIS, both containing the same readings incl. utm_source=bluedot-impact links); and (3) ~20 targeted web searches against bluedot.org confirming unit/chunk titles, URLs (bluedot.org/courses/technical-ai-safety/{unit}/{chunk}), durations, and many resource titles/authors/times. Post-cutoff items (Claude Opus 4.6 system card Feb 2026, Claude Mythos Preview system card Apr 2026, Meta Advanced AI Scaling Framework v2 Apr 2026, Anthropic RSP v3) were independently verified as real via web search. STRUCTURE: 6 units; unit intro chunks (1.1, 1.2, 2.1, 3.2 narrative text) and exercise chunks (1.4 'What future do you want?', 3.x company options exercises, 5.3 'Break the kill chain', 6.3 '1-pager') have no or few external readings; durations shown on the live site per chunk include exercise time. Unit 3's four company options (3/3 Anthropic, 3/4 OpenAI, 3/5 Google DeepMind, 3/6 Meta) and Unit 5's threat-pathway readings are choose-ONE core options; Unit 3's optional resources are organized by dangerous capability (scheming/cyber/biorisk/persuasion) for the 'Evaluating for dangerous capabilities' exercise. Unit 6 'readings' from 6.4-6.7 are BlueDot-written org/fellowship profile cards rather than external readings. 'minutes' = course-listed reading time where shown. The six 'Unit intro video' entries are BlueDot's own embedded YouTube videos (untitled in the scrape). Chunk numbering for 5/2-5/3 and 6/2-6/8 is inferred from sidebar order (6/1, 6/4, 6/5, 6/6, 3/1-3/4, 4/1, 4/2, 5/1, 1/1-1/3, 2/1-2/4 confirmed directly via search-indexed URLs). BlueDot updates this course frequently (e.g., an earlier 2025/early-2026 run used Claude Opus 4.5/Sonnet 4.5 system cards and Gemini 3 Pro FSF report where the current run uses Opus 4.6/Mythos); this snapshot reflects the course as of ~2026-08-20.
